title: WorldCupArena: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Language Models and Deep-Research Agents on Football Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2607.18084v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting a football match before kickoff requires more than knowing past results: a model must use changing information and make a clear prediction before the answer is available. We present WorldCupArena, a dynamic benchmark for language models and deep-research agents. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is its first evaluation, and the same process can be reused for future leagues and cups. Before each match, a model either receives a common evidence package or searches for information itself. It predicts the result and score, likely players and events, match statistics, and the outcome of the competition. After the match, these predictions are compared with the recorded result. We report result accuracy, exact-score accuracy, and a scoreline score that gives some credit when a predicted score is close but not exact, together with scores for the other prediction tasks. translated_title: WorldCupArena：语言模型与深度研究智能体在足球预测任务上的细粒度评估
translated_abstract: 在开球之前预测一场足球比赛，仅仅了解过往比赛结果是远远不够的：模型必须利用不断变化的信息，并在答案揭晓之前做出明确的预测。我们提出了 WorldCupArena，一个面向语言模型和深度研究智能体的动态基准测试。2026年国际足联世界杯是其首次评估场景，且同样的流程可以复用于未来的联赛和杯赛。在每场比赛开始前，模型要么接收一个统一的证据包，要么自行搜索信息。它需要预测比赛结果和比分、可能出场的球员和比赛事件、比赛统计数据，以及整个赛事的最终冠军归属。比赛结束后，这些预测会与实际记录的结果进行对比。我们报告结果准确率、精确比分准确率，以及一个比分评分（当预测比分接近但不完全正确时给予部分分数），同时还包括其他预测任务的评分。在各系统之间，相似的结果准确率可能掩盖了更大的差异……
tldr: 该论文提出了 WorldCupArena，一个以2026年世界杯为首个评估场景的动态基准测试，通过结果准确率、比分准确率等多项细粒度指标，评估语言模型和深度研究智能体在信息动态变化环境下进行赛前足球预测的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces WorldCupArena, a dynamic benchmark using the 2026 FIFA World Cup as its first evaluation, which fine-grainedly assesses language models and deep-research agents on pre-match football forecasting through multiple metrics such as result accuracy and exact-score accuracy.
